packageRules.description: Base tags read pgMAJOR.MINOR-tsLINE.PATCH. Capturing the TimescaleDB line as `compatibility` stops Renovate crossing it: 2.29 dropped PostgreSQL 15, and each line already has its own Dockerfile.
A PostgreSQL major is a new Dockerfile and an export/import migration, never a bump of an existing one.

The alpine base tags read tsLINE.PATCH-pgMAJOR, so the fields swap places: capturing the PostgreSQL major as `compatibility` is what stops Renovate crossing it, and a TimescaleDB line change is a new Dockerfile here too.
A TimescaleDB line bump is a new Dockerfile and a new tag, and it would also need the pinned pg_textsearch and toolkit releases revisited.

TimescaleDB patch releases of the alpine base. No upgrade test runs on this line — it only ever initialises an empty data directory — so the smoke test building and running both compiled extensions is the gate.

What is left is PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB patch releases. The upgrade test starts the previous release, seeds a hypertable, and asserts the new image adopts that data directory with glibc unchanged, so these can land unattended.
